Requested output columns: symbol_id (string).
Return exactly the requested output columns, using each requested name as the column alias, in the requested order. Return complete repository-relative file paths and complete symbol IDs exactly as stored. When the question asks which files, symbols or modules, return each distinct one once unless it asks for occurrences.

WITH RECURSIVE target_symbol AS (
    SELECT symbol_id
    FROM auto_ontology_code.code.symbols
    WHERE name = 'invoke_with_structured_output'
),
direct_callers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT caller_symbol_id
    FROM auto_ontology_code.code.calls
    WHERE callee_symbol_id = (SELECT symbol_id FROM target_symbol)
),
two_hop_callers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.caller_symbol_id
    FROM auto_ontology_code.code.calls c
    WHERE c.callee_symbol_id IN (SELECT caller_symbol_id FROM direct_callers)
),
as_filtered AS (
    SELECT t.symbol_id
    FROM two_hop_callers t
    WHERE t.symbol_id NOT IN (SELECT caller_symbol_id FROM auto_ontology_code.code.calls WHERE callee_symbol_id = (SELECT symbol_id FROM target_symbol))
)
SELECT symbol_id FROM as_filtered;

gold_sql: WITH d AS (SELECT DISTINCT caller_symbol_id AS s FROM code.calls WHERE call_kind = 'direct' AND callee_symbol_id = 'auto_ontology/utils/llm_invoke.py::invoke_with_structured_output') SELECT DISTINCT c.caller_symbol_id AS symbol_id FROM code.calls c JOIN code.symbols x ON x.symbol_id = c.caller_symbol_id JOIN code.files f ON f.file_id = x.file_id WHERE c.call_kind = 'direct' AND c.callee_symbol_id IN (SELECT s FROM d) AND c.caller_symbol_id NOT IN (SELECT s FROM d) AND NOT f.is_test ORDER BY 1
